facts.text: Authority refused building consent BLD0503/20 under s50 for a new dwelling at Ngāruawāhia.
Determination considers whether the application contained sufficient information for the authority to be satisfied on reasonable grounds that the Building Code would be met.
Discussion refers to BRANZ appraisal evidence and drawings for the proposed systems.
Decision: authority correct to refuse building consent under s50; decision confirmed (5 July 2022).
